article.title: Iran-based news site says Supreme Court upholds death sentence for political prisoner months after granting him reprieve
paras: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Persian article.

An Iranian news site says the regime’s Supreme Court has upheld a death sentence on a political prisoner months after granting a reprieve to the man, convicted of causing minor damage to a judiciary building.

In a Wednesday Telegram post, the Emtedad outlet run by the Union of Islamic Iran People Party said the Supreme Court upheld “in the past week” a death sentence issued by Branch 1 of the Rasht Revolutionary Court against Manouchehr Fallah several months ago. Rasht is the capital of northern Iran’s Gilan province.

The Rasht Revolutionary Court’s Branch 2 previously handed Fallah a death sentence in the same case in early 2025 and the Supreme Court upheld it. But the top court overturned that decision early this year on appeal from Fallah’s lawyer and ordered a retrial.

Fallah, who is around 42 years old, has been detained in Rasht’s Lakan Prison. Emtedad said he is enduring “very heavy psychological pressure” from having his death sentence overturned and then re-imposed.

Emtedad said Branch 2 initially sentenced Fallah to death on the charge of “destruction with the intent of confronting the Islamic government” for causing 15 million tomans in damage to the door of the Rasht judiciary building. The damage was worth about $180 at the open-market rate at the time of the sentencing.

Defense lawyer Milad Panahipour wrote on Emtedad last October that Fallah, his client, was accused of detonating a small firecracker in front of the judicial office’s entrance at 12:30am on June 1, 2023. Panahipour said the detonation caused minor damage to the building’s iron door and stone facade and hurt no one.

Emtedad said Panahipour petitioned the Supreme Court for a retrial and cited the lawyer as saying that request was granted earlier this year. The outlet said Fallah’s case was referred to Branch 1, a parallel court, for the retrial, and rights groups reported that the judge issued a new death sentence against the political prisoner in May.
The Emtedad report said Fallah’s re-confirmed death sentence has been referred to the Rasht Criminal Sentence Execution Unit for implementation.
Exiled Iranian human rights groups HRANA and Hengaw have said Fallah was denied access to legal representation during his initial proceedings and was tried by video link in December 2024.

The United States has repeatedly condemned the Islamic republic's use of the death penalty to suppress political dissent. The State Department also has emphasized the necessity of respecting defendants' rights, including access to legal representation and a fair trial.

The Treasury Department sanctioned several Iranian officials in January 2026 for their roles in suppressing protesters. In that announcement, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said his department “will use every tool to target those behind the regime's tyrannical oppression of human rights.”
zh: 一家總部位於伊朗的新聞網站報導，最高法院在給予該名政治犯緩刑數月後，仍維持了對他的死刑判決
編者註：本報導翻譯自美國之音波斯語版原文。
一家伊朗新聞網站報導，該政權的最高法院已維持對一名政治犯的死刑判決，而此前數月，該法院曾因該男子被判定對一棟司法大樓造成輕微損壞，而暫緩執行其死刑。
伊朗伊斯蘭人民黨聯盟旗下的《埃姆泰達德》（Emtedad）媒體週三在Telegram上發文指出，最高法院「在過去一週內」維持了拉什特革命法院第一分庭數月前對馬努切赫爾·法拉赫（Manouchehr Fallah）所作出的死刑判決。拉什特是伊朗北部吉蘭省的省會。
拉什特革命法院第二分庭曾於2025年初就同一案件判處法拉赫死刑，最高法院亦維持原判。但最高法院在今年初接獲法拉赫律師的上訴後，推翻了該判決，並下令重審。
現年約42歲的法拉赫（Fallah）目前被羈押於拉什特（Rasht）的拉坎（Lakan）監獄。埃姆泰達（Emtedad）表示，由於他的死刑判決先被推翻，隨後又被重新判處，他正承受著「極大的心理壓力」。
埃姆特達德表示，第二分庭最初以「意圖對抗伊斯蘭政府而進行破壞」的罪名，判處法拉赫死刑，理由是他對拉什特司法大樓的大門造成1,500萬托曼的損失。根據判決當時的市場匯率，該筆損失價值約為180美元。
辯護律師米拉德·帕納希普爾（Milad Panahipour）去年十月在《Emtedad》網站上撰文指出，他的當事人法拉赫（Fallah）被指控於2023年6月1日凌晨12時30分，在司法機關辦公室入口處引爆了一枚小型鞭炮。 帕納希普爾表示，此次爆炸僅對建築物的鐵門和石材外牆造成輕微損壞，未造成任何人員受傷。
《Emtedad》報導指出，帕納希普爾曾向最高法院提出重審申請，並引述該名律師的說法，表示該請求已於今年稍早獲得批准。該媒體表示，法拉赫的案件已被移交至第一分庭（一個平行法院）進行重審，而人權團體則報導稱，法官於五月對這名政治犯再次判處死刑。
《埃姆泰達報》報導指出，法拉赫經重新確認的死刑判決已移交至拉什特刑事判決執行單位，以待執行。
流亡海外的伊朗人權組織 HRANA 和 Hengaw 表示，法拉赫在初步審理期間被剝奪了聘請法律代表的權利，並於 2024 年 12 月透過視訊方式接受審判。
美國一再譴責伊朗伊斯蘭共和國利用死刑來鎮壓政治異見。國務院亦強調必須尊重被告的權利，包括獲得法律代理及公平審判的權利。
美國財政部於2026年1月針對數名伊朗官員實施制裁，理由是他們在鎮壓抗議者過程中扮演的角色。在該項聲明中，財政部長史考特·貝森特表示，該部「將動用一切手段，鎖定那些在幕後策動該政權對人權實施暴虐壓迫的幕後黑手」。
